simplemaps.guide.page.1.title: Simple Maps
simplemaps.guide.page.1: Wayfinder Maps that show where you have been, a big map screen with waypoints, cartography and map displays on item frames.
simplemaps.guide.page.2.title: Wayfinder maps
simplemaps.guide.page.2: Endless maps, one per dimension: the plain map for the Overworld and other dimensions, a Nether map and an End map.
simplemaps.guide.page.3.title: Map screen
simplemaps.guide.page.3: Use the map to open it: drag to move, mouse wheel or +/− to zoom (1, 4, 8, 16 and 64 blocks per pixel).
simplemaps.guide.page.4.title: Waypoints
simplemaps.guide.page.4: Up to eight waypoints belong to the map itself; they show in the locator bar while the map is in the main or off hand.
simplemaps.guide.page.5.title: Cartography table
simplemaps.guide.page.5: Copy, extend and combine wayfinder maps at the cartography table; each can be switched off on the server.
simplemaps.guide.page.6.title: Maps in item frames
simplemaps.guide.page.6: A framed wayfinder map shows a stored view; right-click opens the map screen, and the frame shows where you scrolled to.
simplemaps.guide.page.7.title: Creative tabs
simplemaps.guide.page.7: The module's items sit in its own creative tab and are also sorted into the fitting Vanilla tabs and the search tab.
